doc: FBL 0.12, sections 8.6 and 8.7, FR-026, FR-027, edge case 18: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/examples/example 2/annotations-and-labels.owm at ad1a4680a with its .adp, unchanged, and its .identities.json with one entry added at its end, the change that makes it this fixture's: an entry of the kind 'evolution', which no rule of the binding declares. The registration has no identities: block, so the legacy file is read: every element of a rule with a sidecar id has the stored id of its kind and key (the anchor Customer in the component kind, the links by their two ends and Dependency, the annotations by number), and none is made anew. The entry of the undeclared kind is kept as written and reported as fbl.stale-view-data at its line. Removing the note prunes its entry by a remove-entry with one separator in the same edit, and the undo puts both back; the undeclared entry is never touched.

attributes.text: Tea is the point of all this

steps.doc: A move of Kettle writes the body alone: its identity entry's key does not change.
